findings.description: The Lambda environment block embeds AWS credentials (access_key = "AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE", secret_key = "wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY") directly in Terraform. Lambda environment variables are stored in cleartext and are readable via the Lambda console/API and in Terraform state, so any real keys committed this way are permanently exposed to anyone who can read the function config or state.

The function uses runtime = "nodejs12.x", which is an end-of-life Node.js runtime no longer receiving security patches. Running untrusted event input on an unmaintained runtime exposes the function to known, unpatched vulnerabilities.
